thread:
noah: Quick postmortem follow-up — I pulled together a single remediation watchlist for the streaming/chat reliability problems. We split into four scopes: proxy/client timeouts, truncated/partial responses detection + retry policy, reconnect/backoff state machine in runtime, and observability/dashboards. Please claim ownership + a target delivery date.

ana: I'll take proxy + client timeout tuning. Plan: tighten read deadlines on proxy, add adaptive timeout based on recent tail-latency, and publish SDK guidance for client-side keepalive/timeouts. Target: 2026-02-08.

li: I'll own truncated/partial response detection and automated retries. Approach: emit `stream.truncated` event with reason codes, attach request id + kv-checksum, and implement a server-side best-effort retry when safe (idempotency checks). Target: 2026-02-12. Ticket REM-2026-99.

gwen: I'll pick up reconnect/backoff state machine in the runtime. Proposed changes: limit resume attempts to 3 per session, exponential backoff with jitter, and add a circuit-breaker per-customer when resume_fail_rate > 0.5%. ETA: 2026-02-05. PR coming.

noah: Obs/telemetry owners? Need dashboards and alerts for three signals: incomplete_streams, resume_fail_rate, proxy_tail_503_rate. Whoever does dashboards should also add a weekly watch alert.

telemetry-bot: I can scaffold dashboards. Will create a Grafana folder `streams/reliability-watch` and add panels for the three signals.

li: Log sample I pulled to help detection logic:

```
2026-01-29T11:47:12Z req_id=0x9b2a stream_id=77 status=truncated tokens_streamed=214 expected=1024 err=EOF
2026-01-29T11:47:12Z req_id=0x9b2a reconnect=1 route=pool-eu-2 latency_ms=5210
2026-01-29T11:47:14Z req_id=0x9b2a final_status=client_closed reason=deadline
```

li: That sequence (truncated -> reconnect -> client deadline) repeats in our heat windows. We'll tag metrics with model and pool.

ana: For client SDK guidance I'll add a short section in the Node/Python SDKs: recommended initial read timeout of 10s, heartbeat every 3s, retry-on-truncated with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts.

gwen: Opening spike PR for the state machine: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1317 (WIP). Current tests show duplicate resume attempts under race; adding per-session lock.

noah: New action list (IDs):
- R-01: Proxy+client timeout tuning — owner: ana — due: 2026-02-08 — Ticket: NET-2026-21
- R-02: Truncated detection + safe retry — owner: li — due: 2026-02-12 — Ticket: REM-2026-99
- R-03: Reconnect/backoff state machine — owner: gwen — due: 2026-02-05 — PR: GH #1317
- R-04: Dashboards + alerts (incomplete_streams, resume_fail_rate, proxy_503_tail) — owner: telemetry-bot — due: 2026-02-01 — Dash path: streams/reliability-watch
- R-05: Weekly syndication + status note — owner: noah — recurring Fridays 09:30 PT

li: Creating REM-2026-99 now and attaching sample logs + thresholds (alert when incomplete_streams > 0.04% 5m).

telemetry-bot: Dashboard created (streams/reliability-watch). Added `Alert:IncompleteStreams` with 5m window, notify #oncall when > 0.04%.

ana: I need a short CI job to inject socket pauses/timeouts into canary to verify client guidance. @ops-bot can you schedule `ci/stream-sim-timeouts`?

ops-bot: Scheduled `ci/stream-sim-timeouts` to run hourly against canary and dedicated pools. Job ID: ci-17901-11.

gwen: STATUS 2026-02-01: PR #1317 updated, added per-session lock and resume attempt cap. Running canary A/B (10% traffic). Observed resume_fail_rate drop from 0.9% -> 0.35% on initial run.

li: STATUS 2026-02-02: telemetry-only patch rolled to canary. `stream.truncated` events are populating and look correctly attributed by model/pool. Opening follow-up for automated retry logic.

ana: STATUS 2026-02-03: proxy timeouts tuned in canary, tail 503s reduced by ~30% during the test window. SDK docs PR opened GH #1322.

noah: NOTE: If any owner needs more time, post a short update here and set the new ETA. We'll treat the weekly Friday sync as the single source of truth.

telemetry-bot: Reminder: weekly watchlist sync in 2 hours.

ops-bot: Planned canary rollout of runtime state-machine to 2026-02-06T02:00Z (10% traffic -> 50% for 1h). Will monitor `resume_fail_rate`, `incomplete_streams`, `proxy_tail_503`.
